reason: S1 only adds convenience constructors for existing wuffs_base__io_reader and wuffs_base__io_writer values. H0's aggregate initialization sets the same buf field while zero-initializing private_impl, so it continues to exercise wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_config, wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_frame, and wuffs_zlib__decoder__decode with equivalent reader/writer state. The added null-pointer branches are trivial construction semantics and do not materially expand the fuzz-relevant attack surface.
